items.source: Warning regarding multipart mails: Simple MIME messages that just contain HTML text but no inline elements or attachments will work on more or less any email client that is capable of HTML rendering. However, inline elements and attachments are still a major compatibility issue between email clients: It's virtually impossible to get inline elements and attachments working across Microsoft Outlook, Lotus Notes and Mac Mail. Consider choosing a specific multipart mode for your needs: The javadoc on the MULTIPART_MODE constants contains more detailed information.
items.translation: 关于多部分邮件的警告：仅包含 HTML 文本但不含内联元素或附件的简单 MIME 消息，可以在任何支持 HTML 渲染的电子邮件客户端中正常工作。然而，内联元素和附件仍然是电子邮件客户端之间的主要兼容性问题：几乎不可能让内联元素和附件在 Microsoft Outlook、Lotus Notes 和 Mac Mail 之间正常工作。请根据您的具体需求选择合适的多部分模式：MULTIPART_MODE 常量的 javadoc 中包含更详细的信息。

items.source:
This was Spring 1.0's default behavior. It is known to work properly
on Outlook. However, other mail clients tend to misinterpret inline
elements as attachments and/or show attachments inline as well.
items.translation: 这是 Spring 1.0 的默认行为。已知其在 Outlook 上能正常工作。然而，其他邮件客户端往往会将内联元素误解释为附件，并且/或者也会将附件以内联方式显示。

items.source:
This was the default behavior from Spring 1.1 up to 1.2 final.
This is the "Microsoft multipart mode", as natively sent by Outlook.
It is known to work properly on Outlook, Outlook Express, Yahoo Mail, and
to a large degree also on Mac Mail (with an additional attachment listed
for an inline element, despite the inline element also shown inline).
Does not work properly on Lotus Notes (attachments won't be shown there).
items.translation:
这是从 Spring 1.1 到 1.2 final 版本的默认行为。
这是"Microsoft multipart 模式”，即 Outlook 原生发送的模式。
已知在 Outlook、Outlook Express 和 Yahoo Mail 上能正常工作，在 Mac Mail 上也能在很大程度上工作（尽管内联元素也会以行内形式显示，但仍会列出额外的附件）。
在 Lotus Notes 上无法正常工作（附件将不会在那里显示）。

items.source:
This is the default since Spring 1.2.1. This is arguably the most correct
MIME structure, according to the MIME spec: It is known to work properly
on Outlook, Outlook Express, Yahoo Mail, and Lotus Notes. Does not work
properly on Mac Mail. If you target Mac Mail or experience issues with
specific mails on Outlook, consider using MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED instead.
items.translation: 自 Spring 1.2.1 起，这已成为默认设置。根据 MIME 规范，这可以说是最正确的 MIME 结构：已知其在 Outlook、Outlook Express、Yahoo Mail 和 Lotus Notes 上能正常工作，但在 Mac Mail 上无法正常工作。如果您针对 Mac Mail 或在 Outlook 中遇到特定邮件的问题，请考虑使用 MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED。

items.source:
Texts and inline elements can either be stored in the root element
itself (MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED, MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED) or in a nested element
rather than the root element directly (MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED_RELATED).
items.translation: 文本和行内元素可以存储在根元素本身（MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED、MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED）中，或者存储在嵌套元素中而不是直接存储在根元素中（MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED_RELATED）。

items.source:
By default, the root MimeMultipart element will be of type "mixed"
(MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED) or "related" (MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED).
The main multipart element will either be added as nested element of
type "related" (MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED_RELATED) or be identical to the root
element itself (MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED, MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED).
items.translation: 默认情况下，根 MimeMultipart 元素的类型为"mixed"(MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED)或"related"(MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED)。主要 multipart 元素将作为类型为"related"(MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED_RELATED)的嵌套元素添加，或与根元素本身相同(MULTIPART_MODE_MIXED, MULTIPART_MODE_RELATED)。
